tasks.title: Quarter-wave element length
tasks.solution: λ = c/f, a quarter is λ/4. On a real conductor the element is slightly shorter (a velocity factor of 0.95–0.97), so the antenna is trimmed by SWR.

tasks.title: Loss from rotating linear antennas
tasks.solution: Received power ∝ cos²θ, loss = −20·lg(cos θ). 45° is 3 dB, 90° is infinite in theory and 20+ dB in practice. Circular polarization removes this dependence on bank.
